improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
improve.coach: 43% overall, 20% in your last five. Better every week.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
improve.coach: Flagged 43% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.
improve.coach: 36% overall, 60% recently. Red flag, small one.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Goals are the sweet tea of football, and you poured a glass. 57% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You're the opener on the team's toolbelt. 43% consistency. Bankable.
